summary: Mars Survival Challenge is an exciting survival game where players lead a team of astronauts to build and protect a colony on Mars. Players must manage water, food, oxygen, electricity and health, complete missions, build shelters and survive dangerous dust storms. The goal is to keep the colony alive for 30 days using teamwork, smart decisions and resource management. 🚀
details: It's about how can the player save astronauts on mars in 30 days.
